phase22_password_security_verdict.q1_isCeoPasswordPermanentlySeeded: No. Seeded as initial bootstrap password; can be changed voluntarily via /auth/change-password.
phase22_password_security_verdict.q2_canCeoChangeOwnPassword: YES. Authenticated CEO can call POST /auth/change-password with current and new password.
phase22_password_security_verdict.q3_isFirstLoginChangeEnforced: NO for initial seeded CEO/Manager. YES for new staff accounts provisioned by admin via /admin/users.
phase22_password_security_verdict.q4_doesForgotPasswordWork: PARTIAL. Cryptographic token generation and verification work; external SMTP email delivery is unconfigured.
phase22_password_security_verdict.q5_resetEmailProvider: PROVIDER NOT CONFIGURED / LOCAL TOKEN GENERATION ONLY.
phase22_password_security_verdict.q6_canManagerResetCeoPassword: NO. Manager cannot access user administration routes (HTTP 403 Forbidden).
phase22_password_security_verdict.q7_canCeoResetManagerPassword: YES. CEO can trigger administrative password reset via POST /admin/users/:id/reset-password.
phase22_password_security_verdict.q8_arePasswordsHashed: YES. Bcrypt with 10 salt rounds used for all user passwords.
phase22_password_security_verdict.q9_areResetTokensSingleUse: YES. Token is set to null immediately upon successful password reset.
phase22_password_security_verdict.q10_doResetTokensExpire: YES. Token expires 1 hour after generation (resetPasswordExpires: Date.now() + 3600000).
phase22_password_security_verdict.q11_areSecretsAbsentFromFrontend: YES. Verified zero API keys or DB credentials embedded in Vite client bundle.
phase22_password_security_verdict.q12_areCredentialsAbsentFromLogs: YES. Passwords and full credit/banking details are sanitized from console logs and audit entries.

finalVerdict.rationale: Core CRM, RBAC, Team Management, AI Control Center, Safe Mode, Hunter Human Gate, and Quote workflows are rock-solid and production-hardened. Minor pre-acceptance items: (1) Configure real SMTP for Forgot Password emails, (2) Implement dedicated customer feedback collection form, (3) Configure Google Review CTA URL in post-trip completion flow.
